mechanism: Itraconazole inhibits CYP3A4, increasing prochlorperazine plasma concentrations and risk of toxicity; both drugs prolong QT interval and have anticholinergic effects.
action: Monitor for increased prochlorperazine adverse effects (extrapyramidal symptoms, anticholinergic effects); consider dose reduction of prochlorperazine or alternative antifungal; monitor ECG for QT prolongation.
